hero.title: Master Your Finances with Elegance
hero.subtitle: Imhotep Finance gives you complete clarity over your wealth, multi-currency assets, expenses, and savings targets.

features.title: Everything you need for financial freedom
features.multiCurrencyDesc: Track balances across multiple currencies with automated real-time conversion into your preferred primary currency.
features.savingsTargetDesc: Define financial milestones and watch your score adapt in real-time as your net worth progresses.
features.recurringDesc: Never miss a bill or pay cycle. Recurring transactions execute seamlessly with zero manual stress.
features.wishlistDesc: Plan your luxury and personal purchases, set priorities, and convert them to transactions with one click.

mobileApp.title: Finance on the Go
mobileApp.subtitle: Download the mobile app for iOS and Android with biometric lock, instant notifications, and offline caching.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.content: Your privacy is paramount. Imhotep Finance encrypts your financial data and never shares or sells your information.
